title: When the Contact Wakes
premise: Ivo Nakamura, a ghost in the private security world, is hired to guard a client whose charter flight vanishes from every tracking system mid-flight—yet the plane lands, and the passenger who steps off claims to be the defector Ivo was never told about. As Ivo digs into the erased flight, they discover their own identity has been quietly rewritten by the same hands, and that the extraction scheduled for dawn is a trap designed to burn every operative involved. To survive, Ivo must decide whether to extract the defector—who may be bait—or expose the network that made them both disposable. In the end, Ivo gets the defector onto a different plane entirely and feeds the real flight plan to the hunters, letting the trap close on its architects while walking away with nothing but a new name.
about_author: Coral Whitlock is a former aviation logistics analyst who spent six years routing charters through jurisdictions that preferred not to be named. She writes thrillers from a coastal town where the fog rolls in exactly on schedule.

chapters.title: Ghost Rate
chapters.summary: Ivo Nakamura takes a cash contract guarding a nervous tech executive at a private terminal, establishing their reputation for unattributable work. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: controlled detachment masking a hunger to matter to someone.

chapters.title: The Client Nobody Trusts
chapters.summary: The executive reveals he's brokering a defection and needs Ivo for one night only—a handoff at a regional airfield. Ivo notices the payment came from three shell companies stacked like a warning. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: unease dressed as professionalism.

chapters.title: Squawk 1200
chapters.summary: At the airfield, Ivo watches the inbound charter on radar apps out of habit—and watches it vanish from every feed while controllers still talk to it. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the cold drop of realizing reality has been edited.

chapters.title: Still in the Air
chapters.summary: The plane lands anyway; the man who steps off carries documents naming Ivo's own old callsign. The executive's handler orders everyone to pretend nothing happened. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: vertigo—the past reaching back.

chapters.title: Paper Ghost
chapters.summary: Ivo pulls their own records and finds employment history altered, a dead sister added, a decade of contracts reassigned to someone else. POV: Ivo, with a flashback to their first job. Emotional beat: grief weaponized against them.

chapters.title: The Defector's Story
chapters.summary: The defector, Mara Voss, tells Ivo she carried out a data trove proving the flight-erasure tool exists—but her details contradict the executive's version. POV: alternating Ivo/Mara. Emotional beat: wary mutual recognition of two people built from lies.

chapters.title: Handlers and Leashes
chapters.summary: Ivo traces the shell companies to a private intelligence firm called Meridian Lattice and realizes they've been on its books for years without knowing. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Holed up in a safehouse, Ivo counts exits, ammo, hours until the dawn extraction flight, and the odds each option offers. Mara tests Ivo's loyalty with a half-truth. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: intimacy under siege.

chapters.title: The Second Plane
chapters.summary: Ivo discovers the manifest lists two aircraft—one for the defector, one for whoever cleans up after. The cleanup crew is already in country. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into clarity.

chapters.title: Old Callsign
chapters.summary: A former colleague, Deniz, surfaces claiming Meridian sent him to protect Ivo; his story checks out just well enough. Ivo must decide whether loyalty survives when truth doesn't. POV: Deniz. Emotional beat: longing for a team that may not exist anymore.

chapters.title: Interrogation by Candlelight
chapters.summary: Mara admits she may have been sent as bait to flush out rogue operators—including Ivo—but insists the data trove is real. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: confession without absolution.

chapters.title: Terminal Silence
chapters.summary: The executive turns up dead in a way staged to look like Ivo's signature work. Every camera in the city suddenly works again. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: being hunted by your own reflection.

chapters.title: Deniz's Choice
chapters.summary: Deniz reveals Meridian ordered him to deliver Ivo alive and Mara's data destroyed; instead he gives Ivo the extraction coordinates and buys time with his own capture. POV: Deniz. Emotional beat: redemption priced in blood.

chapters.title: Reading the Bait
chapters.summary: Ivo dissects the extraction plan and finds it engineered so any survivor will be blamed for everything—bait confirmed, but the hook is also an opportunity. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: cold strategic hope.

chapters.title: The Airfield at Midnight
chapters.summary: Ivo and Mara infiltrate the airfield under cover of a fueling delay, planting Ivo's true flight plan where Meridian's watchers will find it. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into precision.

chapters.title: Contact
chapters.summary: Meridian's cleanup team springs the trap on the decoy flight while Ivo and Mara sprint for the real charter; a firefight erupts across the apron. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: adrenaline stripped of glory.

chapters.title: What Mara Carried
chapters.summary: Mid-escape, Mara reveals the trove includes Ivo's original file—who recruited them and why—which means saving her means learning what Ivo truly is. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: identity hanging on a stranger's word.

chapters.title: Wheels Up
chapters.summary: They board as the decoy burns on the far runway; the pilot is Meridian's, and Ivo must take the cockpit at gunpoint-turned-negotiation. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: command reclaimed from chaos.

chapters.title: Climax: The Lattice Closes
chapters.summary: Meridian's director corners them via radio, offering Ivo their old identity back in exchange for Mara. Ivo broadcasts the director's voiceprint and the erased-flight evidence to every news desk instead. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: choosing truth over self.

chapters.title: Landing in Daylight
chapters.summary: They land in a neutral country as Meridian begins eating itself; journalists swarm, and Ivo stays behind glass, watching their old name become headline. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: survival that feels like loss.

chapters.title: The Price Itemized
chapters.summary: Weeks later, Deniz is freed in a prisoner swap nobody claims credit for; Ivo meets him once, says nothing about forgiveness, and pays his debts anonymously. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: quiet accounting of what survival cost.

chapters.title: New Squawk Code
chapters.summary: Under a name no database holds yet, Ivo takes a small honest contract guarding a family nobody wants dead—and answers the radio with a callsign all their own. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: guarded, earned peace.
